name: zvideo_dd3d_submit_poly_color_attr
description: zVideo_dd3d::SubmitPolyColorAttr prepares color/specular attributes, then queues or immediately draws opaque color-attribute triangle fans.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo polygon submission pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ab320 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall vertices in ECX with stack packedColor16/baseColor/attr1/attr0/attr2/alpha/vertexCount/renderParam/queueMode arguments, ret 0x20 cleanup, and no return value.

The function ignores packedColor16 for the D3D attribute path, computes attr1Scale as 1.0 - attr1[0], prepares alpha bits, writes reversed specular values from attr2 or 0xff000000 when attr2 is null, and writes color values from either baseColor * attr1Scale or per-vertex attr0-biased/normalized RGB.
Retail behavior returns immediately after color/specular preparation when alpha is below 255; only alpha >= 255 proceeds to reverse-copy positions and either queue or draw geometry.

Opaque queueMode != 0 appends an overwrite queue entry of type 3 and memcpy-copies the prepared TL vertices. Opaque queueMode == 0 updates cached D3D texture-handle and shade-mode state as needed, then calls IDirect3DDevice2::DrawPrimitive with D3DPT_TRIANGLEFAN, D3DVT_TLVERTEX, the temporary TL vertex buffer, vertexCount, and flags 0.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4ab320 has no warning tags. Direct callees are _ftol provider glue, zError::ReportOldNoOp at tier S, and zVideo_dd::ReportError at tier C or better; the 0x7c8ed0 frontier token corresponds to Binary Ninja __builtin_memcpy for rep movsd. Direct3D calls are provider vtable dependencies.

Native smokes verify alpha-below-255 preparation without queue/draw, attr0/attr2 reversed color/specular writes, opaque overwrite queue type 3 behavior, immediate D3D render-state cache updates, DrawPrimitive provider arguments, and cache-hit immediate draw behavior.
